records.statement: Bitquery's public incident trace reads full transfers through approximately 02:10 UTC on Ethereum and 02:40 UTC on other chains, with holdings snapshots at 06:43 UTC on October 30. These are stale by the October 31 11:21 UTC research cutoff; no raw XRPL account_info was executed.

Bitquery says all 17 drained hot wallets carry Binance PoR labels, including five XRPL accounts. This partially resolves label membership but does not independently re-parse Binance's raw official export or establish same-time XRP customer liabilities and reserve coverage.

ETH transfer quantities do not fully reconcile across public reports: CoinDesk's two source amounts sum to 195,469.6 ETH; it reports a 195,460 ETH transfer to the second address; Bitquery reports a 197,460 ETH balance at 06:43; CoinDesk gives an aggregate of approximately 204,500 ETH. The differences may reflect additional transfers or scope differences but are unresolved.
